bugs.error_message: Build error: Invalid end tag at line 1425 in Conference.vue
bugs.root_cause: Unescaped </script> tag inside template literal in exportPDF() function. Vue SFC compiler interprets </script> inside <script setup> as the end of the script block, regardless of template literal context.
bugs.fix: Escape as <\/script> in the template literal string.

bugs.error_message: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'value') at chunk-FSE3T7JS.js:27464 — ExportPDF component crash
bugs.root_cause: @vavt/v3-extension ExportPDF component tries to access undefined ModalToolbar ref in onMounted. Fundamentally incompatible with md-editor-v3 v6.5.0.
bugs.fix: Removed ExportPDF entirely. Replaced with custom exportPDF() using window.open() + document.write() + window.print().

bugs.error_message: Markdown rendering showing raw source code instead of rendered content in exports
bugs.root_cause: renderRichContent() from @/utils/renderContent only handles bold/italic/code/LaTeX. Does NOT support headings, tables, blockquotes, ordered lists, links, images, horizontal rules.
bugs.fix: Installed marked (npm) and replaced renderRichContent() with marked.parse() for renderedConfDocument computed.

bugs.error_message: Duplicate const store = useAppStore() after replacing MarkdownEditor imports in QuestionBank.vue
bugs.root_cause: Edit tool replaced import line, but new_string included store/useAppStore imports that already existed, creating duplicate store declaration
bugs.fix: Removed duplicate const store = useAppStore() via Edit tool

bugs.error_message: IDE diagnostic: Element is missing end tag at Homework.vue:47 — <el-watermark> wrapper around tracking table never closed
bugs.root_cause: When adding <el-watermark v-if="elWmProps" v-bind="elWmProps"> wrapper to the visible tracking <el-table>, the closing </el-watermark> tag and <template v-else> fallback were never added to the edit. This left an unclosed tag, breaking the Vue SFC template.
bugs.fix: Added </el-watermark> after </el-table>, then added <template v-else> with a duplicate <el-table> (same columns/behavior) for the watermark-disabled fallback.

bugs.error_message: 后台系统折叠导航部署后无法复原，一直处于折叠状态 — 用户反馈
bugs.root_cause: 屏幕宽度≤1200px时CSS强制侧边栏折叠，但header中切换按钮只调用store.toggleSidebar()改变sidebarCollapsed状态，不触发sidebarOpen overlay状态，导致中等屏幕点击切换按钮无效。
bugs.fix: 新增handleSidebarToggle()函数，根据window.innerWidth判断：≤1200px时切换sidebarOpen（移动端overlay），>1200px时切换store.sidebarCollapsed（桌面端折叠）。

bugs.error_message: 管理后台/学生门户页面切换卡住，网页崩溃 — 无限重定向循环
bugs.root_cause: RBAC改造后 loadUserFromStorage() 读取新键 dse_admin_user，但旧登录系统存储的是 admin_user 键。router guard 检查到 admin_token 存在但 currentUser 为 null → 重定向到 /login → Login.vue onMounted 检测到 admin_token 存在 → 重定向回 /admin → 无限循环直至浏览器崩溃。
bugs.fix: 1) loadUserFromStorage() 增加旧键 admin_user 回退并自动迁移到新键 2) Login.vue onMounted 增加 store.isAuthenticated 验证 3) router guard 中 admin→login 重定向也验证 isAuthenticated 4) guard 中清理无用户数据的过期 token
